items.title: AI Swarm v3 – Self-host your own headless AI agents
items.raw_excerpt:
Website: https://ai-swarm.dev GitHub: https://github.com/ai-swarm-dev/ai-swarm Hey everyone, I just released v3 of AI Swarm. It is basically a way to host your own Claude Code or Gemini agents on your own infrastructure. I built it because I wanted to be able to build and deploy features for my apps from my phone or IDE, without having to watch it create the code and being unable to use it while it's deploying and fixing bugs for 30 minutes. I took inspiration from Kilo Code's Cloud Agents and decided to build it myself. It runs in Docker and uses Temporal for workflow orchestration. Main Features:
- Self-Hosted: Deploy to your own Linux box running your apps or dev environment. It can deploy to remote servers via SSH.
- Claude Code and Gemini CLI: Built-in support for both, including Z.ai

I built it because I wanted to be able to build and deploy features for my apps from my phone or IDE, without having to watch it create the code and being unable to use it while it's deploying and fixing bugs for 30 minutes. items.title: An LLM response cache that's aware of dynamic data
items.raw_excerpt: Raymond here from Butter.dev, an LLM response cache built as a chat-completions proxy. Today we're launching a key feature for the platform: the ability to generalize on dynamic, templated inputs. Caching at the HTTP request level has the obvious problem of generalizability. Nearly no request is identical, due to templated variables (like names) and metadata (like timestamps), so exact-match cache lookups rarely hit. We solve this at Butter by using LLMs to detect dynamic content in requests and derive their inter-relationships, allowing the cache entry to be stored as a template + variables + deterministic code. La respuesta no está en la publicidad omnipresente, sino en las situaciones reales de los usuarios.

Following the popularity of Ant Group's "Ant Fortune," OpenAI has also decided to enter the AI healthcare field. It is reported that one month after the new version of Ant Fortune was released, its latest monthly active users reached 30 million, with daily user inquiries exceeding 10 million, doubling in just one month. It connects to 5,000 hospitals nationwide and 300,000 real doctors for online consultations, and supports integration with smart devices from ten major brands including Apple, Huawei, OPPO, vivo, and Yuwell. items.title: 「一脑多形」圆桌：世界模型、空间智能在具身智能出现了哪些具体进展？｜GAIR 2025
items.raw_excerpt: 在 12 月 13 日举行的第八届GAIR全球人工智能与机器人大会“数据&一脑多形”分论坛上，一场有关“一脑多形”的圆桌论坛，将整个会场气氛推向高潮，在英诺天使基金 ED 王建明的主持下，浙江大学控制学院副教授，微分智飞创始人高飞，宁波东方理工大学助理教授金鑫，上海人工智能实验室青年科学家王靖博三位嘉宾围绕着具身智能、空间智能、世界模型等话题进行了热烈讨论。 通过主持人特有的投资人式、抽丝剥茧的提问，围绕着几位学者的研究和创业方向，我们可以了解到当下最火热的世界模型、空间智能在具身智能领域的研究进展和细节，从而得以穿透资本笼罩在世界模型、空间智能的迷雾，看到具身智能当下遇到的挑战与机遇。 具身智能技术路线仍未收敛 王建明：三位学者研究的方向都非常不一样，开场先问一个共性的问题热热场，大家怎么看过去两年具身智能的发展？ 高飞：现在还没到技术路线收敛的时候，还属于探索阶段，这是好事，有发散才有机会。这波具身智能的热潮，大家本质期待的还是 AI 结合本体能带来的智能性的飞跃。我认为从发散探索到技术路线收敛、到最后落地阶段，大家还是要记住自己做具身智能的初心是什么。如果不是为了通用泛化智能，最后这个领域又收敛回工业自动化了，可能就没有太大的意义了。 金鑫：我也非常同意高老师的看法，我感觉这两年留给高校的机会相对产业界来讲比较少，希望未来更多把具身智能的核心问题交给高校去突破，比如交互、人机协同、多智能体、世界模型等等抽象出的关键问题，产业去做更落地的事情。希望未来两年能看到高校跟企业更好地合作、平衡。 王靖博：相比较在纯数字世界中做一些例如scaling up 的事情，我更关注具身智能软硬件的 code design，比如人形机器人十年前的波士顿动力 Atlas 就展示出了很好的运动能力，但它并没有从实验室的产品进入产业界，当有了较好的软硬件的 code design，可能

excerpt_i18n.zh: 在 12 月 13 日举行的第八届GAIR全球人工智能与机器人大会“数据&一脑多形”分论坛上，一场有关“一脑多形”的圆桌论坛，将整个会场气氛推向高潮，在英诺天使基金 ED 王建明的主持下，浙江大学控制学院副教授，微分智飞创始人高飞，宁波东方理工大学助理教授金鑫，上海人工智能实验室青年科学家王靖博三位嘉宾围绕着具身智能、空间智能、世界模型等话题进行了热烈讨论。 通过主持人特有的投资人式、抽丝剥茧的提问，围绕着几位学者的研究和创业方向，我们可以了解到当下最火热的世界模型、空间智能在具身智能领域的研究进展和细节，从而得以穿透资本笼罩在世界模型、空间智能的迷雾，看到具身智能当下遇到的挑战与机遇。 具身智能技术路线仍未收敛 王建明：三位学者研究的方向都非常不一样，开场先问一个共性的问题热热场，大家怎么看过去两年具身智能的发展？ 高飞：现在还没到技术路线收敛的时候，还属于探索阶段，这是好事，有发散才有机会。这波具身智能的热潮，大家本质期待的还是 AI 结合本体能带来的智能性的飞跃。我认为从发散探索到技术路线收敛、到最后落地阶段，大家还是要记住自己做具身智能的初心是什么。如果不是为了通用泛化智能，最后这个领域又收敛回工业自动化了，可能就没有太大的意义了。 金鑫：我也非常同意高老师的看法，我感觉这两年留给高校的机会相对产业界来讲比较少，希望未来更多把具身智能的核心问题交给高校去突破，比如交互、人机协同、多智能体、世界模型等等抽象出的关键问题，产业去做更落地的事情。希望未来两年能看到高校跟企业更好地合作、平衡。 王靖博：相比较在纯数字世界中做一些例如scaling up 的事情，我更关注具身智能软硬件的 code design，比如人形机器人十年前的波士顿动力 Atlas 就展示出了很好的运动能力，但它并没有从实验室的产品进入产业界，当有了较好的软硬件的 code design，可能
excerpt_i18n.en:
At the "Data & One-Brain-Multiple-Forms" sub-forum of the 8th GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Summit on December 13, a roundtable discussion on "One-Brain-Multiple-Forms" brought the event to a climax. Moderated by Wang Jianming, Executive Director of Inno Angel Fund, three guests—Gao Fei, Associate Professor at Zhejiang University's College of Control Science and Engineering and founder of Differential Intelligence Flight; Jin Xin, Assistant Professor at Ningbo Oriental Institute of Technology; and Wang Jingbo, Young Scientist at Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory—engaged in a lively discussion on topics such as embodied intelligence, spatial intelligence, and world models. Through the moderator's distinctive investor-style, probing questions focused on the scholars' research and entrepreneurial directions, the audience gained insights into the latest advancements and details of the currently trending world models and spatial intelligence in the field of embodied intelligence. This helped cut through the capital-driven haze surrounding world models and spatial intelligence, revealing the current challenges and opportunities in embodied intelligence.

The technological path of embodied intelligence has not yet converged.

Wang Jianming: The research directions of the three scholars are quite different. To start, let's warm up with a common question: How do you view the development of embodied intelligence over the past two years?

Gao Fei: It is not yet time for the technological path to converge; we are still in the exploration phase, which is a good thing—divergence creates opportunities. The essence of this wave of enthusiasm for embodied intelligence lies in the expectation of a leap in intelligence through the integration of AI with physical entities. I believe that from divergent exploration to the convergence of technological paths and eventual implementation, we must remember our original purpose in pursuing embodied intelligence. If it is not for generalizability and versatility...
excerpt_i18n.es: En el foro "Datos y un cerebro, múltiples formas" de la octava conferencia global GAIR sobre inteligencia artificial y robótica, celebrada el 13 de diciembre, una mesa redonda sobre "un cerebro, múltiples formas" llevó la atmósfera del evento a su punto culminante. Moderada por Wang Jianming, director ejecutivo del fondo de ángeles Inno Angel, tres invitados —Gao Fei, profesor asociado de la Facultad de Control de la Universidad de Zhejiang y fundador de Differential Intelligence Flight; Jin Xin, profesor asistente de la Universidad Oriental de Ciencia y Tecnología de Ningbo; y Wang Jingbo, joven científico del Laboratorio de Inteligencia Artificial de Shanghai— mantuvieron un animado debate sobre temas como la inteligencia encarnada, la inteligencia espacial y los modelos del mundo. A través de las preguntas características del moderador, propias de un inversor y meticulosamente desglosadas, se exploraron las investigaciones y emprendimientos de estos académicos.

excerpt_i18n.en: The "2025 Shanghai 'AI+Manufacturing' Development White Paper," compiled by the Shanghai Industrial Internet Association, has been officially released. It reveals that as of December 24, 2025, Shanghai has completed the registration of 139 large-scale AI models and has nearly 300,000 professionals in artificial intelligence, accounting for approximately one-third of the national total. The "Shanghai highland" in artificial intelligence is rapidly emerging.
excerpt_i18n.es: El Libro Blanco sobre el Desarrollo de "IA+Fabricación" en Shanghái 2025, compilado por la Asociación de Internet Industrial de Shanghái, ha sido publicado oficialmente. Revela que, hasta el 24 de diciembre de 2025, Shanghái ya ha registrado 139 modelos de gran tamaño, contando con cerca de 300,000 profesionales especializados en inteligencia artificial, lo que representa aproximadamente un tercio del total nacional. El "altiplano de Shanghái" en inteligencia artificial está acelerando su ascenso. (Shanghai Securities News)
